name: Multi-Dimensional Gender Bias Classification Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating gender bias in text along multiple pragmatic and semantic dimensions, including bias from the gender of the person spoken about, spoken to, and the speaker. It includes a novel crowdsourced evaluation benchmark of utterance-level gender rewrites.
reputation: A niche but well-cited benchmark from the bias-evaluation literature, mainly used in research on gender bias and fairness in language models.
notes: Includes automatic annotation of eight large scale datasets with gender information and a crowdsourced evaluation benchmark for utterance-level gender rewrites.
